nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.description: Backend follows modular layered architecture: API -> Router -> Service -> Repository -> Database.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection
nodes.description: FastAPI dependency injection for database sessions, authentication, permissions, and shared services.

nodes.label: Input Validation
nodes.description: Every external input must be validated including request bodies, query parameters, file uploads, user data.

nodes.label: Backend Guidelines
nodes.description: Backend architecture, development standards, implementation rules, and layered architecture patterns.

nodes.label: No Business Logic in Routers
nodes.description: Routers must NOT contain business logic; logic belongs in services.

nodes.label: Validate All Input
nodes.description: Every external input must be validated; never trust client input.

nodes.label: Pydantic Schemas Required
nodes.description: Every API endpoint must have request and response schemas; never return SQLAlchemy models directly.
